text:
harry: heads-up: the Next.js LangChain sample is flaking in evals. We batch 4 embeddings and sometimes get a missing item + duplicate id when a retry fires.
jena: is this the monorepo starter or the slim sample?
harry: slim starter at samples/next-langchain-lite. Node SDK @redwood/sdk@0.9.1.
omar: logs?
harry: short log: request ids [r1,r2,r3,r4] -> responses [r1,r3,r2,r2] (r4 missing, r2 duplicated).	ess: that looks like a partial retry merged back incorrectly. Are we deduping by client id on retry?
omar: current JS retry merges chunks naively. Python SDK dedupes and preserves order. Parity gap.
jena: quick sample patch: in api/embed.ts map results by item.id then return in original order. Added SAMPLE_DEDUPE=true in .env so CI uses the stable path.
devex-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1147 labels: sdk,bug,parity
omar: plan: add dedupe+stable-order to JS SDK retry path. Propose an option `stableBatch=true` defaulting to true for now to match Python. We'll benchmark perf impact.	ess: for eval harness add tests: 1) assert all input ids present, 2) assert no duplicates, 3) assert ordering preserved. Run test under concurrency to reproduce.
harry: I've opened sample PR with env note and small helper: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/3012
jena: assign @omar for SDK PR, @tess for harness tests, @harry to update README.
omar: will draft SDK PR and include microbench numbers at 100 qps to quantify any overhead.	ess: once SDK fix merges we'll remove SAMPLE_DEDUPE gating in samples and add an integration test to avoid regressions.
harry: thanks team — saving repro steps and logs in the issue.
